peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 16.4% below its local comparables; 24 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (65.4): 3.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 251 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 12). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $920,388 ($1,824 psf, 473–871 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,182 psf (range $1,586–2,887); 16.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $181,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Paya Lebar MRT about 460 m, Aljunied MRT about 600 m; closer than 383 of 662 similar developments (the same as 12). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Geylang Methodist School (Primary) about 470 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 260 m), more than 513 of 662 similar developments (the same as 79); nearest hawker centre Blk 117 Aljunied Market And Food Centre about 480 m; nearest park Aljunied Park about 1,510 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Blk 117 Aljunied Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 580 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 980 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,050 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,550 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,640 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,690 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,720 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 305 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 408 new sales and 663 resales (1,071 purchases); new sales were 38.1% of these purchases. Subsales (67) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 663 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 236 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 663 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 803 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−17.4%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
